'''Wodl Eraanl''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Standing two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, he was trained in [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming, security, repair and specifically [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair, and use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and technology. He wore a [[shirt]], pants and shoes and carried a blaster, [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], a computer [[repair kit]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and a mini-computer.<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wodl Eraanl was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Eraanl's character type was listed as "Engineer" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
